name: xyz.quantumatlas/nft-collab-5050-hub
title: NFTCOLLAB Creator Drops & Partner Releases
description: NFTCOLLAB Base MCP: creator & partner drops, UCP checks, safety preflight, staging & receipts.

tools.name: collab_get_hub_policy
tools.description:
Read canonical contract constants, 50/50 split rules, $5.00 buyer floor, $2.00 staging fee, and the 4 compliance walls for the Base DropERC1155 hub. Use this first for hub rules; do not use to compute per-wallet payouts (collab_calculate_5050_split) or screen draft metadata (collab_preflight_drop_safety).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; returns static authoritative policy, or HTTP 503 if the collaboration service is unreachable.

tools.name: collab_calculate_5050_split
tools.description:
Model exact per-edition 50/50 payouts across Base USDC and Stripe card rails before staging. Use this for creator pre-launch math; do not use for buyer checkouts on live drops (collab_quote_edition_purchase) or safety checks (collab_preflight_drop_safety).
Parameters: collaborators[*].share_bps sum to 10000 (or 5000 gross) and scale across the creator 50% half after business_partners cuts (<= 90%); conflicting cut_bps/cut_pct fails HTTP 422.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; odd cents round +1c to Treasury (>= 50.0% platform floor); HTTP 422 duplicate/blocked wallets.

edition_price_cents.description: Proposed buyer mint price in integer USD cents (500 = $5.00 floor up to 1,000,000 = $10,000).

supply.description: Maximum ERC-1155 edition supply (1 to 100,000 copies; defaults to 50 when omitted).

name.description: Creator or co-creator public display name (1-80 chars).

share_bps.description: Creator share in basis points summing to 10,000 across creators (or 5,000 of gross).

collaborators.description: Ordered list of 1 to 16 creator collaborators (index 0 is lead creator) sharing the remaining creator 50% pool.

name.description: Business partner display name (e.g. "Downtown Music Venue", "Coastal Promoter").

cut_bps_of_creator_half.description: Partner cut in basis points (50..9000 = 0.5%..90%) carved strictly out of the creator 50% half.

cut_pct_of_creator_half.description: Alternative percentage (0.5..90%) of the creator 50% half (30 = 30% of creator half = 15% gross).

business_partners.description: Optional list of up to 8 B2B partner wallets taking an agreed cut (combined <= 90%) out of the creator 50% half.

secondary_royalty_bps.description: Secondary market royalty in basis points (0 to 1500; defaults to 750 = 7.5%).

tools.name: collab_issue_quarantine_ticket
tools.description:
Register a media digest, MIME type, byte size, and magic-byte header into nftcollab-media-vault quarantine prior to staging. Use this before collab_stage_5050_drop to bind verified media; do not use to check copy (collab_preflight_drop_safety) or stage drops (collab_stage_5050_drop).
Parameters: filename extension must match mime_type with zero path separators; sample_header_b64 checks magic bytes (RIFF..WEBP, ftyp) and rejects script polyglots.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; deterministic qtk_* ID cached 7d in Redis bound to creator_wallet; HTTP 422 on bad MIME/wallet.

filename.description: Base media filename with matching safe extension (e.g. "cover01.png" or "master.flac"; no slashes or ..).

mime_type.description: Declared safe media MIME type matching the filename extension and binary header.

byte_size.description: Total media file size in bytes (64 bytes up to 262,144,000 = 250 MB).

sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest of the media file.

sample_header_b64.description: Optional base64-encoded first 16-64 bytes of the file to verify container magic bytes.

tools.name: collab_preflight_drop_safety
tools.description:
Screen real proposed drop metadata, media URIs, wallet splits, and quarantine ticket against all 4 compliance walls at zero cost. Use this to validate user inputs before paying to stage; do not use for synthetic receipt fixtures (collab_preview_stage_drop) or live staging (collab_stage_5050_drop).
Parameters: evaluates all 4 walls without short-circuiting; audio_preview_uri requires audio_preview_sha256, and quarantine_ticket_id verifies wallet + MIME parity.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; returns HTTP 200 with passed=false and violations[] on compliance failures (zero state mutation).

title.description: Proposed drop title (3-140 chars to pass; screened for protected artist, municipal, and celebrity likenesses).

description.description: Proposed drop description (10-4000 chars to pass; screened against APY, profit-share, passive-income, and raffle claims).

edition_price_cents.description: Proposed buyer mint price in USD cents (values < 500 return an explicit floor violation).

supply.description: Maximum ERC-1155 edition supply (1 to 100,000 copies; defaults to 50 when omitted).

name.description: Creator or co-creator public display name (1-80 chars).

share_bps.description: Creator share in basis points summing to 10,000 across creators (or 5,000 of gross).

collaborators.description: Ordered list of 1 to 16 creator collaborators (index 0 is lead creator) sharing the remaining creator 50% pool.

name.description: Business partner display name (e.g. "Downtown Music Venue", "Coastal Promoter").

cut_bps_of_creator_half.description: Partner cut in basis points (50..9000 = 0.5%..90%) carved strictly out of the creator 50% half.

cut_pct_of_creator_half.description: Alternative percentage (0.5..90%) of the creator 50% half (30 = 30% of creator half = 15% gross).

business_partners.description: Optional list of up to 8 B2B partner wallets taking an agreed cut (combined <= 90%) out of the creator 50% half.

cover_image_uri.description: Public https:// (port 443, non-private host) or ipfs:// cover artwork URI.

cover_image_sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest of the media file.

cover_image_mime.description: Cover artwork MIME type ("image/png" default, "image/jpeg", or "image/webp"; SVG/HTML forbidden).

audio_preview_uri.description: Optional public https:// or ipfs:// audio/video preview URI (requires audio_preview_sha256).

audio_preview_sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest of the media file.

audio_preview_mime.description: Optional audio/video master MIME type ("audio/wav", "audio/flac", "audio/mpeg", "audio/mp4", or "video/mp4").

sample_header_b64.description: Optional base64-encoded first 16-64 bytes of cover image for magic-byte verification.

quarantine_ticket_id.description: Optional qtk_* ID from collab_issue_quarantine_ticket to pre-verify wallet and digest binding.

rights_attestation_accepted.description: Must be true to pass Wall D (attests 100% original IP, DMCA consent, and 50/50 split).

tools.name: collab_preview_stage_drop
tools.description:
Generate a deterministic sandbox fixture showing the exact response envelope of collab_stage_5050_drop without compliance screening or payment. Use this only to test client JSON parsing; do not use to validate real drop copy/URIs (collab_preflight_drop_safety) or stage a real drop (collab_stage_5050_drop).
Parameters: omitting title or edition_price_cents injects valid sample defaults; values < 500 still test 422 floor rejection.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; returns synthetic cdrop_sandbox* fixture with sandbox=true and touches no Redis or chain state.

title.description: Optional sample drop title echoed into the synthetic sandbox receipt.

edition_price_cents.description: Optional sample edition price in USD cents (500 to 1,000,000; defaults to 2000).

tools.name: collab_stage_5050_drop
tools.description:
Lock a 50% Atlas Treasury / 50% Creator & B2B Partner deal on Base DropERC1155 and stage into moderation. Run collab_preflight_drop_safety first; do not use for receipt fixtures (collab_preview_stage_drop) or editing staged drops (collab_update_staged_drop).
Parameters: supply spend_key/header or payment_signature; reuse idempotency_key + collaborators[0].wallet on retries (mutated fields -> HTTP 409).
Behavior: pre-payment safety gate runs first so HTTP 422 rejections charge $0.00; settled calls debit $2.00, set staged_pending_approval (mint_performed=false), and issue Ed25519 receipt; HTTP 402 unpaid.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen idempotency key (4-128 chars, e.g. "drop-harbor-synth-v1") binding creator ownership and retry safety.

title.description: Drop title (3-140 chars; no celebrity, municipal, or protected artist names).

description.description: Drop description (10-4000 chars; no passive-income, APY, profit-share, or raffle claims).

edition_price_cents.description: Buyer mint price in USD cents (minimum 500 = $5.00).

supply.description: Maximum ERC-1155 edition supply (1 to 100,000 copies; defaults to 50 when omitted).

name.description: Creator or co-creator public display name (1-80 chars).

share_bps.description: Creator share in basis points summing to 10,000 across creators (or 5,000 of gross).

collaborators.description: Ordered list of 1 to 16 creator collaborators (index 0 is lead creator) sharing the remaining creator 50% pool.

name.description: Business partner display name (e.g. "Downtown Music Venue", "Coastal Promoter").

cut_bps_of_creator_half.description: Partner cut in basis points (50..9000 = 0.5%..90%) carved strictly out of the creator 50% half.

cut_pct_of_creator_half.description: Alternative percentage (0.5..90%) of the creator 50% half (30 = 30% of creator half = 15% gross).

business_partners.description: Optional list of up to 8 B2B partner wallets taking an agreed cut (combined <= 90%) out of the creator 50% half.

cover_image_uri.description: Public https:// or ipfs:// cover artwork URI (quarantined until operator approval).

cover_image_sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest of the media file.

cover_image_mime.description: Cover artwork MIME type ("image/png" default, "image/jpeg", or "image/webp"; SVG/HTML forbidden).

audio_preview_uri.description: Optional public https:// or ipfs:// audio/video preview URI (requires audio_preview_sha256).

audio_preview_sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest of the media file.

audio_preview_mime.description: Optional audio/video master MIME type ("audio/wav", "audio/flac", "audio/mpeg", "audio/mp4", or "video/mp4").

sample_header_b64.description: Optional base64-encoded first 16-64 bytes of cover image for magic-byte verification.

quarantine_ticket_id.description: Optional qtk_* ID from collab_issue_quarantine_ticket owned by one of the collaborators.

origin_class.description: Optional media provenance declaration stamped into the signed atlas.media.capture_receipt.v1 receipt (defaults to undeclared).

event_id.description: Optional LiveLoop event ID linked to this drop capture receipt.

destination_id.description: Optional destination slug linked to this drop capture receipt.

chain_anchors.description: Optional existing Base Mainnet EAS or transaction anchor references (no gas tx is forced).

rights_attestation_accepted.description: Must be true to lock the 50/50 split and IP/DMCA attestation.

spend_key.description: Optional Stripe-funded spend key (sbk_*) to settle the $2.00 staging fee without crypto (or pass x-atlas-spend-key header).

payment_signature.description: Optional Base Mainnet USDC x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload for the $2.00 staging fee.

builder_code.description: Optional registered ERC-8021 partner builder_code for disclosed post-settlement attribution.

tools.name: collab_update_staged_drop
tools.description:
Update metadata/pricing or withdraw an unapproved staged_pending_approval drop as its lead creator. Use this to revise copy, price, or supply before moderation; do not use for operator decisions (collab_moderate_staged_drop) or staging new drops (collab_stage_5050_drop).
Parameters: lead_creator_wallet plus the original idempotency_key prove creator ownership; action="update" re-runs all 4 safety walls on changed fields, whereas action="cancel" withdraws the drop and ignores metadata fields.
Behavior: zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; returns HTTP 403 on wallet/key mismatch, HTTP 404 unknown drop_id, HTTP 409 once approved or frozen, and HTTP 422 on safety violations.

drop_id.description: 50/50 Collaboration Hub drop identifier (format: cdrop_<20 hex chars>).

action.description: Lifecycle action: "update" edits title/description/price/supply while pending; "cancel" withdraws the drop.

lead_creator_wallet.description: Lead creator wallet (collaborators[0].wallet) used when staging the drop.

idempotency_key.description: Original idempotency_key used in collab_stage_5050_drop proving creator authority over drop_id.

title.description: Updated drop title when action="update" (re-screened through Walls A-C).

description.description: Updated drop description when action="update" (re-screened through Walls A-C).

edition_price_cents.description: Updated buyer mint price in USD cents (>= 500) when action="update".

supply.description: Maximum ERC-1155 edition supply (1 to 100,000 copies; defaults to 50 when omitted).

reason.description: Optional creator audit note recorded on the revision or cancellation.

tools.name: collab_list_moderation_queue
tools.description:
List staged, approved, rejected, or frozen collaboration drops in the operator review queue, including unredacted quarantined media URIs for inspection. Use this as a platform operator before calling collab_moderate_staged_drop; do not use for public buyer browsing (collab_list_live_drops).
Parameters: supply operator_token or x-collab-operator-token header; status defaults to "staged_pending_approval" (pass "all" to inspect every lifecycle state).
Behavior: zero charge, constant-time token verification, 60 req/min/IP; returns HTTP 403 on missing/invalid operator token and HTTP 503 if operator secret is unconfigured.

status.description: Queue lifecycle filter (defaults to "staged_pending_approval"; pass "all" for every state).

limit.description: Maximum queue items to return newest-first (1 to 100; defaults to 50).

operator_token.description: Authorized platform operator token (optional when supplied via x-collab-operator-token HTTP header).

tools.name: collab_moderate_staged_drop
tools.description:
Execute an operator moderation decision (approve, reject, or emergency DMCA/safety freeze) on a collaboration drop. Use this after reviewing collab_list_moderation_queue; do not use for creator self-edits (collab_update_staged_drop) or read-only status checks (collab_get_drop_status).
Parameters: supply operator_token or x-collab-operator-token header; decision="approve" releases quarantined media and opens quoting, "reject" closes review, and "freeze" redacts media and halts sales.
Behavior: zero charge, constant-time token check, idempotent per target state; returns HTTP 403 on bad token, HTTP 404 unknown drop_id, and HTTP 503 if unconfigured.

drop_id.description: 50/50 Collaboration Hub drop identifier (format: cdrop_<20 hex chars>).

decision.description: Moderation decision: "approve" -> approved_live, "reject" -> rejected, "freeze" -> frozen_dmca_or_safety kill-switch.

note.description: Optional moderation or DMCA reference note recorded on the drop.

operator_token.description: Authorized platform operator token (optional when supplied via x-collab-operator-token HTTP header).

tools.name: collab_list_live_drops
tools.description:
Browse operator-approved live 50/50 community drops published under https://nftcollab.xyz/community/<drop_id>. Use this to discover purchasable drops; do not use to inspect pending, cancelled, rejected, or frozen drops (collab_get_drop_status or collab_list_moderation_queue).
Parameters: category filters by edition archetype while limit and offset paginate newest-first results across total_matching live drops.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; non-live drops are excluded unconditionally (returns empty drops[] with count=0 when none match).

limit.description: Page size of newest-first approved_live drops to return (1 to 100; defaults to 25).

offset.description: Zero-based offset for paginating approved_live drops alongside limit (defaults to 0).

tools.name: collab_get_drop_status
tools.description:
Inspect a single collaboration drop across any lifecycle state (staged_pending_approval, approved_live, cancelled_by_creator, rejected, or frozen_dmca_or_safety). Use this when you have a cdrop_* ID; do not use to browse live drops (collab_list_live_drops) or read payout settlements (collab_list_drop_settlements).
Parameters: drop_id requires the exact cdrop_<20 hex> identifier; quarantined media URLs remain null until approved_live, and frozen drops redact title, description, and media.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; returns HTTP 404 when drop_id does not exist and HTTP 422 when malformed.

drop_id.description: 50/50 Collaboration Hub drop identifier (format: cdrop_<20 hex chars>).

tools.name: collab_quote_edition_purchase
tools.description:
Compute a buyer checkout quote and community_checkout_url handoff for 1 to 25 editions of an approved_live drop. Use this for buyer mint prep on an existing drop_id; do not use for creator split modeling (collab_calculate_5050_split) or payout history (collab_list_drop_settlements).
Parameters: quantity cannot exceed supply (HTTP 409 if exceeded); rail="usdc_x402" quotes fee-free Base USDC, whereas "card_stripe" deducts 2.9%+$0.30 plus $0.01/edition gas before 50/50 split.
Behavior: zero charge; buyer settlement intentionally completes at community_checkout_url so MCP never touches buyer keys; returns HTTP 404 missing, HTTP 409 not live, HTTP 422 blocked wallet.

drop_id.description: 50/50 Collaboration Hub drop identifier (format: cdrop_<20 hex chars>).

buyer_wallet.description: Buyer Base EVM wallet address receiving the ERC-1155 edition(s) (screened against sanctioned/burn addresses).

quantity.description: Number of ERC-1155 editions to quote in one checkout (1 to 25; defaults to 1).

rail.description: Buyer payment rail to quote ("usdc_x402" default on Base or "card_stripe" USD card checkout).

tools.name: collab_list_drop_settlements
tools.description:
Read recorded 50/50 buyer edition settlements and configured creator/B2B partner payout shares for a specific collaboration drop. Use this to audit per-drop mint revenue and payout allocations; do not use to inspect general drop metadata (collab_get_drop_status) or verify one JWS signature (collab_verify_payment_receipt).
Parameters: drop_id selects the drop while limit caps newest-first settlement rows (defaults to 50).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; returns payout_recipients[] plus settlements[] (empty array before first buyer mint); returns HTTP 404 unknown drop_id and HTTP 422 malformed ID.

drop_id.description: 50/50 Collaboration Hub drop identifier (format: cdrop_<20 hex chars>).

limit.description: Maximum settlement records to return (1 to 200; defaults to 50).

tools.name: collab_verify_payment_receipt
tools.description:
Verify a detached Ed25519 JWS receipt against Atlas Fleet keys — supports x402 execution, LiveLens visual evidence, two-tier corroboration, and media capture receipts. Do not use to check drop moderation state (collab_get_drop_status).
Parameters: pass attestation (schema or contract in supported Atlas types); optional expected_media_sha256 verifies local media hash without uploading media.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 60 req/min/IP; stateless check returning valid/verified boolean, origin_class, and trust boundary note, or HTTP 400 on unsupported schema.

schema.description: Attestation schema identifier (for execution or media capture receipts).

contract.description: Contract identifier (for LiveLens visual evidence or two-tier corroboration receipts).

attestation.description: Detached Ed25519 JWS receipt object returned by Atlas x402, NFTCOLLAB drop staging, or LiveLens.

response_b64.description: Optional base64-encoded raw JSON response bytes (<= 8 MB) for x402 execution receipt digest checks.

expected_media_sha256.description: Optional client-computed SHA-256 hex digest of a local media file to compare against the signed receipt without uploading media bytes.

tools.name: collab_inspect_ucp_merchant
tools.description:
Audit a B2B partner domain for Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 2026-08-25) support and MCP shopping readiness before co-staging a 50/50 drop. Use this to verify Shopify or merchant UCP capabilities; do not use to calculate splits (collab_calculate_5050_split).
Parameters: pass merchant (public https:// URL or domain such as "shop.example.com") and optional include_tools (default true).
Behavior: read-only, SSRF-hardened, zero charge; fetches /.well-known/ucp without redirects, intersects capabilities with Atlas buyer profile, and probes tools/list.

merchant.description: Public merchant domain or HTTPS origin to inspect for /.well-known/ucp support (e.g. "x402.quantumatlas.xyz" or "https://merchant.myshopify.com").

include_tools.description: When true (default), also query tools/list on the merchant dev.ucp.shopping MCP endpoint to enumerate offered operations.
